title: A seat listed in bseat still bids and its bid is accepted uncontested

knownGap.note: BidRequest.wseat (§3.2.1) restricts which buyer seats are allowed to bid. Crosscheck never reads seatbid.seat, wseat, or bseat at all — a seat outside the wseat allow-list is indistinguishable from an authorized one.
